description: Latest insider transactions from SEC Form 4 filings (EDGAR, refreshed about once a minute), newest filed first, up to 100 rows: ticker, insider, role, code (P buy, S sale, ...), shares, price, dollar value, dates and the filing link. Defaults to open-market buys and sales filed in the last 7 days.

code.description: Transaction codes: P = open-market buy, S = sale (default P,S); also A (grant), M (option exercise), F (tax withholding), G (gift) ... or all

days.description: Filed in the last N days when no from date is given (1-45)

insider.description: Insider name (part of it, e.g. musk) or their SEC CIK number

minValue.description: Only trades worth at least this many US dollars (shares × price)

plan.description: Rule 10b5-1 trading plans: exclude (only discretionary trades) or only

ticker.description: One ticker or up to 25, comma separated (e.g. NVDA,AAPL). Empty = every company

name: insider_trades
title: Latest insider trades (SEC Form 4)
